purpose: Canonical successful Style B run used to regression-test the reusable recipe, not its brand copy.

scriptBeats.narration: This keychain-sized case is hiding a full-sized stainless-steel straw.
A reusable straw only works if you actually remember to bring it.
Inside, linked stainless-steel segments unfold until the whole thing snaps straight.
When you're done, it collapses into its case and clips back onto your keys.
Carry FinalStraw and skip the plastic.

visualContract.visualWorld: one bright blue/cyan blueprint-grid 3D explanation world across all six frames
visualContract.demonstrator: silent semi-stylized 3D man with dark backward cap, white sunglasses on cap, pink polo, and tan cargo shorts
visualContract.narrator: omniscient voiceover; the demonstrator never lip-syncs

accepted: One coherent visual world with varied cameras and physical states.
Multiple readable visual beats inside each ten-second clip.
Exact character identity carried from the style master into every production anchor.
A rejected clip can be regenerated without replacing approved upstream work.
rejected: One slow continuous transformation with no internal shot changes.
Treating a generated clip as approved.
Dropping connector words from renderer captions.
